description: This file contains functions and logic for performing security audits on communication channels, including assessing DMs policies, resolving account configurations, and collecting security findings for channels in a system.

methods.name: classifyChannelWarningSeverity
methods.description: Determines the severity level of a warning message based on its content.

methods.name: dedupeFindings
methods.description: Removes duplicate security findings from a list based on key attributes.

methods.name: hasExplicitProviderAccountConfig
methods.description: Checks if a specific account is explicitly configured for a provider in the system configuration.

methods.name: formatChannelAccountNote
methods.description: Formats a note string about the account, indicating if multiple accounts or explicit paths are involved.

methods.name: collectChannelSecurityFindings
methods.description: Main function that collects and returns security audit findings for channels based on configuration and plugins.
